name: Engine RPM
description: Finds engine RPM: idle, rev to the limiter in first, back to idle.
setup: Stopped, first gear, foot off the throttle.
intro: Engine RPM. Start stopped in first gear. I'll ask you to floor it to the rev limiter, then come back to a stop.

steps.say: Idle. Stay stopped, foot off the throttle.
Floor it in first, and hold it on the limiter.
Lift off and brake to a stop. Stay in first or neutral.
